rationale: The base station had only 6 of 8 devices bound, so capacity was not the issue. Logs showed "pairing window expired: no join request received" because the customer was pairing from downstairs (far beyond the required 1-metre range) and pressed the SYNC button once instead of holding it for 3 seconds. Moving the sensor next to the base station and holding the button correctly resulted in immediate successful pairing.

repair_steps: Confirm base station has fewer than 8 devices bound (capacity not exceeded).
Check pairing logs for 'no join request received' indicating sensor not heard.
Instruct customer to move sensor within 1 metre of base station during pairing.
Instruct customer to hold SYNC button for 3 seconds until LED blinks blue continuously.
Verify successful pairing in app and device status online.
output.customer_reply: Thank you for your patience. The issue was not capacity but pairing distance and button press. Please pair the sensor within 1 metre of the base station and hold the SYNC button for 3 seconds until the LED blinks blue. Your sensor is now paired successfully. If you need further help, let us know.

results.text: HB-100 owner could not add a new door sensor; app showed E-201. Base station already had 8 devices. Customer removed an old test sensor and pairing succeeded. Resolved at frontline.

Put the base station into pairing mode from the app (Add Device). Then hold the SYNC button on the camera or sensor for 3 seconds until its LED blinks blue. Keep the peripheral within 1 metre of the base station during pairing. Pairing times out after 120 seconds. After pairing, the device can be moved to its final location.

Solid blue: online and connected to cloud. Blinking blue: pairing mode (lasts 120 seconds). Solid red: no internet uplink. Blinking red: booting or firmware update in progress, do not unplug. Solid purple: storage almost full (over 95 percent).

SEN-D1 1.0 upgrades to 1.3, SEN-M1 1.1 upgrades to 1.4. CAM-I2 hardware revision A with firmware 1.2 cannot be upgraded to protocol v3.
